title: Cairo Citadel and the Muhammad Ali Mosque
summary: Saladin began the Cairo Citadel in AD 1176; its walls took under seven years and the works were completed in 1207, and later rulers added buildings up to Muhammad Ali. His mosque inside the citadel was begun in 1830 and its walls, domes and minaret were finished by his death in 1848. Its central dome is 21 m across.

uncertainty.note: Walls begun AH 572 / AD 1176; completion of works AD 1207 per the Discover Islamic Art entry. The Muhammad Ali Mosque dates 1830–1848. End is the present.
